comments.comment: As the younger sister of a disabled person, I am SO thankful my mother saw the inherent value in my brother’s life, regardless of diagnosis. Doctors encouraged her to abort me because they thought I would be disabled too. Our country’s utter disregard for human dignity regardless of ability is sickening. People just simply refuse to be inconvenienced, and it’s wicked and deplorable. We should be surrounding ourselves with people of all abilities to live and learn alongside one another and build one another up with love. It’s not easy, but every life has worth and dignity, no matter a diagnosis.
If I had their mentality then my one son wouldn’t have been born. We were told that he would never walk or talk. Guess what? He’s 33 and is fine.

No one is guaranteed a "healthy" life! None of those tests done in utero will tell you if the baby has markers for autism, cancer, autoimmune disease, diabetes etc. If you can't handle even the POTENTIAL idea of your child being ill or medically compromised you shouldn't be having children!

This is weird...not your video but to be the parent of one watching this trend. I use to be offended when people would say "i could never" bc...its your kid what do you mean? I think i even have rants online about this...... mine turned 19 this month and im starting to understand bc caregiver fatigue wasnt something I recognized til recently. Yall are missing in this convo most humans aren't built for this. And it doesn't end at 18. You pay a little of money to the govt to "buy" them at 18 if you dont want them lost in the system to continue round the click care til one of you dies. It is a completely different thing than a child with a disability. We need to not shame people not built for this to not take it on. I do not regret my choice, my son saved me. It isnt the discussion anyones having bc everyone is forgetting they are eternal puppies, they grow up and this world requires you, full time, forever to protect, care for, provide, decided..... thats not standard parenting. Its not safe for most humans to do this life. The amt if sleep loss alone with medical needs required on that...
This is crazy. I can’t wrap my head around this
How it sounds to literally everyone with a conscience, a moral compass, and a heart

never mind the fact that they could have had a kid that was born perfectly normal who developed issues later on. or God forbid one or the other of them develop some issues and we all know how that would end. life is not a fantasy sitting behind a TV screen. it has challenges. when we engage in life, we face the challenges. this whole topic is just so heartbreaking and gross. every life matters. everyone has abilities and talents. we have a whole generation of sociopaths coming up and they need to grow the f****** frankly
I still can’t believe that couple. Disgusting
